questions.question: What are the three sentences of a LinkedIn cold outreach message?
questions.expected_passage: p.1 §Exploration: Commonality, Curiosity, Call-to-Action. Sentence 1 states what you have in common; sentence 2 what you are looking for; sentence 3 takes the friction out (e.g. 'Any chance you have 10 minutes for a quick Zoom chat?').

questions.question: Should I put my college grade point average on my resume?
questions.expected_passage: Session #2 - Resume Format (p.2) / Resume Workshop #2 (p.2): 'Remove undergrad GPA because the moment it's added it opens you up to comparison.' Reworded on purpose: the source says 'undergrad GPA', not 'college grade point average'.

questions.question: What should a networking outreach message include?
questions.expected_passage: LinkedIn p.1 §Exploration (commonality, curiosity, call-to-action) + Resume & Networking p.5-6 §Networking for Success outreach principles (short <100 words, ask for 15-20 minutes, no mention of looking for jobs, state your connection up front, generalize interest, it's about them).
